static: harsh analog VHS tape static, loud white noise hiss with crackle and a low hum, a tape ending on a blank channel
glitch: a very short VHS tape tracking glitch: a warbling distorted electrical crackle and a brief buzz
tape_hiss: constant soft analog videotape hiss and faint mechanical motor whir, steady, loopable
breath: one slow quiet human exhale very close to a microphone, muffled, no voice
mall_hum: an empty shopping mall at night, low steady air conditioning drone and faint fluorescent light buzz, distant, loopable
switch: an old security camera multiplexer switching channels: a dry relay click with a tiny burst of static
store_hum: a small closed clothing store at night: quiet ventilation hum and a faint fluorescent light buzz, no people, no music, loopable
crt_hum: a small security guard office at night with a wall of old CRT monitors: steady high-pitched television whine and low electrical hum, loopable
step: one single footstep of a work boot on a hard polished stone floor in a large empty hall, close, with a short echo
zoom: the small electric zoom motor of a 1990s handheld camcorder whirring, heard through its own microphone
curtain: a fitting room curtain pulled open fast: metal rings scraping along a rail in one long sweep
whoosh: a man spinning round fast holding a camcorder: a jacket rustle and a muffled whoosh of air past the microphone
sting: a sudden loud analog horror jump scare stinger: a violent burst of distorted VHS static with a deep low impact and a harsh metallic screech, very loud, then cut
